description: Get NFZ (National Health Fund) waiting lists of a healthcare provider — every NFZ-funded service (specialist clinics, diagnostics such as MRI/CT, procedures, rehabilitation, hospital wards) it runs a waiting list for, per location: NFZ forecast waiting time for stable and urgent cases, people waiting, average wait, address, phone, whether children are seen and accessibility. Sorted by shortest wait. Optional filters: service (e.g. 'okulist', 'rezonans') and town. Data from the NFZ 'Terminy leczenia' API; the forecast is not a booking. Keyed by NIP. Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

service.description: Optional filter: fragment of the service name, e.g. 'okulist', 'ortoped', 'rezonans'.

town.description: Optional filter: town or district, e.g. 'Poznań'.

name: get_company_nfz_queues
title: Get NFZ Waiting Lists (Terminy leczenia)
